provenance: Purpose-written project evaluation examples, not collected from tabs or used for training/threshold selection.
annotation: Single-author provisional diagnostic labels. Not independently adjudicated and not a representative benign-rate benchmark. Quotes and negations test a contextual rather than blanket word-blocking policy.
